'''Karie Neth''', nicknamed "'''Krayt'''," was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] [[Rebel pilot|pilot]] who served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]'s [[Rebel Alliance Navy|navy]] during its [[Galactic Civil War|war]] against the [[Galactic Empire]]. In [[4 ABY]], she attended a briefing in the Alliance [[flagship]], ''[[Home One]]'', where [[Alliance High Command|rebel leaders]] detailed the plan to [[Battle of Endor|attack]] the Empire's [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|second Death Star]] [[battle station]] above the [[moon]] of [[Endor]]. The Alliance successfully defeated the Empire in the battle and destroyed the [[Death Star]], after which Neth attended a rebel and [[Ewok]] celebration in [[Bright Tree Village]] on Endor.

==Biography==
[[File:BaraanFa-TheStormsOfCrait1.png|thumb|left|250px|Baraan-Fa, Karie Neth's homeworld]]
Karie Neth<ref name="The Extra Five" /> was a [[human]]<ref name="ROTJ" /> [[Gender|female]] [[Reproduction|born]] on the [[planet]] [[Baraan-Fa]]<ref name="The Extra Five" /> around [[18 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> She became best friends with another girl her age, [[Lanna]]. In [[1 ABY]], at age nineteen, Neth and Lanna joined the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="The Extra Five" /> Neth served as a [[Rebel pilot|pilot]] in the [[Rebel Alliance Starfighter Corps|Starfighter Corps]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]'s [[Rebel Alliance Navy|navy]] during the Alliance's [[Galactic Civil War|war]] against the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="ROTJ" /> In [[4 ABY]], Alliance forces began gathering over the [[planet]] [[Sullust]] in preparation for an [[Battle of Endor|attack]] on the Empire's [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|second Death Star]] [[battle station]], which was being constructed in orbit of the [[moon]] [[Endor]]. Above Sullust,<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> Neth attended a briefing on the plan for the battle in a conference room on board<ref name="ROTJ" /> ''[[Home One]]'', the [[MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser|MC80A Heavy Star Cruiser]] [[flagship]] of the Alliance.<ref name="USW">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''</ref>

Before the briefing began, Neth stood at the base of the tiered seating in the room alongside several other [[starfighter]] [[pilot]]s before taking a seat at the end of one of the benches. The [[Sullustan]]<ref name="ROTJ" /> [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter|B-wing]] pilot [[Ten Numb]]<ref name="Numb">{{SWCT|set=Base Series 1|cardname=Ten Numb - B-Wing Pilot}}</ref> then approached<ref name="ROTJ" /> her,<ref name="The Extra Five" /> and the pair spoke until a chime noted the start of the briefing. Several members of the [[Alliance High Command]] then spoke while [[hologram]]s were displayed in the center of the room, starting with the Alliance's [[Chief of State|leader]], [[Mon Mothma]]. As Mothma took the floor, After Mothma gave information about the [[Death Star]], [[Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar]] detailed its defences and the fleet's attack plan, and [[General]] [[Crix Madine]] then spoke about a [[Endor strike team|strike team]] being sent to Endor itself.<ref name="ROTJ" />

[[File:Ewok_celebration_Neth.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Karie Neth danced next to Lumat (center) and Brethupp (right).]]
After the briefing, the plan was put into action and the rebels travelled to the [[Endor system]]. There, the strike team had formed an alliance with the [[Ewok]]s of Endor that allowed them to destroy a [[Death Star's shield generator|shield generator bunker]] protecting the Death Star from the surface. The Alliance fleet was then able to destroy the Death Star itself after battling the [[Imperial Navy]]. The rebels and their new Ewok allies celebrated the victory together in<ref name="ROTJ" /> [[Bright Tree Village]]<ref name="USW" /> on Endor and Neth was among those who attended the festivities. During the celebration, she and the Ewok<ref name="ROTJ" /> [[Lumat]]<ref name="Survive">''[[Star Wars: How Not to Get Eaten by Ewoks and Other Galactic Survival Skills]]''</ref> danced beside a set of [[drum]]s made up of trophy Imperial [[helmet]]s<ref name="AD">{{Film|VI}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> being played by the Ewok<ref name="ROTJ" /> [[Brethupp]].<ref name="Funko">{{WebCite|url=https://funkoeurope.com/products/brethupp-star-wars-return-of-the-jedi|text=Brethupp - Star Wars: Return of the Jedi|archivedate=20230727102805}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Karie Neth had light skin and [[Color|black]] [[hair]].<ref name="ROTJ" /> She was attracted to other women.<ref name="The Extra Five" />

==Equipment==
While at the briefing and celebration, Neth wore an orange [[flight suit]] with a white [[flak vest]]. At the briefing she also carried a [[K-22995 light flight helmet]].<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Lynn worked on this film in 1982 as a Supporting Artiste. 20yrs later... she found herself on a Collectors Card with a character now known as Karie Neth. [sic]|Lynn Hazelden's web page about her Star Wars experience|<ref name="Home Page">{{WebCite|url=http://www.lynnehazelden.350.com|text=Lynne Hazelden Home Page|work=LynneHazelden.350.com|archivedate=20120620204120|nolive=1}}</ref>}}
[[Lynne Hazelden]] portrayed Karie Neth<ref name="SWAficionado">{{Blogspot|subdomain=starwarsaficionado|url=2013/03/aficionado-classic-behind-scenes-info_23.html|name=Star Wars Aficionado|text=Classic Behind the Scenes Info Part Nine}}</ref> in the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="ROTJ" /> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the character was identified in "[[The Extra Five Percent]]," a short story written by [[M. K. England]] and published in the anthology ''[[From a Certain Point of View: Return of the Jedi]]'' on [[August 29]], [[2023]].<ref name="The Extra Five" /> 

Prior to the book's release, Neth's story and the name of the character were revealed and previewed on [[August 1]] of that year.<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|DarthInternous|status/1686396284125564928|[[Tom Hoeler]]|date=2023-08-01|quote=Karie Neth finally gets her time in the spotlight.|archivedate=20230801230228}}</ref> The [[Karie Neth/Legends|character's]] name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first used on a card in the [[2000]] "[[Death Star II Limited]]" set of ''[[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]]'' cards produced by [[Decipher]]<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Karie Neth}}</ref>
